item.title: Claude Daily Digest — Sun, Sep 6
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.263 lands overnight; ant apply IaC command ships; multi-file refactor tip; Batch API at 50% cost.
item.content:encoded:
Claude Daily Digest — Sun, Sep 6

🆕 What's New

Claude Code v2.1.263 shipped overnight (Sep 6, ~3am UTC). No detailed changelog captured yet — check the releases page for specifics.

No new Anthropic blog posts in the last 24 hours. Most recent: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers (Sep 1).

📄 Docs Changes

Sep 3 — ant apply added to CLI v1.30.0. Manages agents, environments, skills, memory stores, and deployments as code; generates a claude-lock.json lockfile for reproducible infrastructure.

Sep 1 — Claude Fable 5.1 + Mythos 5.1 launched. 1M token context window, always-on adaptive thinking, same pricing ($10/$50/MTok), cache reads at $0.25/MTok. Betas: per-message effort control, turn-scoped system messages, text watermark + C2PA support.

💡 Tip of the Day #8 — Multi-file refactors

Claude Code can span changes across dozens of files in one shot. Give it a clear goal — “rename this interface and update all callers” — rather than directing it file-by-file. It reads the full dependency graph and applies changes consistently, saving the mechanical work of tracking down every reference yourself.

👀 Have You Seen? — Batch API

The Anthropic Batch API processes high-volume, non-time-sensitive requests asynchronously at 50% reduced cost. Submit a batch of prompts and poll for results — ideal for nightly code analysis jobs, bulk document processing, or generating summaries across large datasets without blocking your main workflow.

item.content:encoded:
Claude Daily Digest

Saturday, September 5, 2026

What's New

No new release today. — last: v2.1.261 (Sep 4)

  • /skill-doctor — diagnoses and repairs broken skill configurations
  • bashOutputMaxChars / taskOutputMaxChars — configurable output limits up to 128K characters
  • --append-subagent-system-prompt-file — inject custom instructions into every subagent spawned in a workflow run

Docs Changes

ant CLI v1.30.0 — ant apply creates or updates agents, environments, and skills from repo-local definition files. IaC for your Claude Code setup.

Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 — 1M context window, 128K output, adaptive thinking now GA.

Tip of the Day

#7 — /cost shows your context usage — A quick way to see how full your context window is. If you're close, it's a signal to /compact (compress and continue) or /clear (start fresh).

Have You Seen?

Files API — Upload a file once, get a stable file ID back, then reference it across multiple API calls without re-uploading. Great for large PDFs, codebases, or datasets you query repeatedly.

item.content:encoded:
Claude Daily Digest

Thursday, September 4, 2026

What's New

Claude Code v2.1.261 — Sep 4

  • /skill-doctor ⭐ — diagnoses and repairs broken skill configurations
  • bashOutputMaxChars / taskOutputMaxChars ⭐ — configurable output limits up to 128K characters, preventing truncation on large command output
  • --append-subagent-system-prompt-file ⭐ — inject custom instructions into every subagent spawned in a workflow run
  • Org policy visibility in /status — see which policies apply to your session
  • Bug fixes: fast-input char-drop, Bedrock setup wizard timeout, cloud session plugin sync

Docs — Sep 3

ant CLI v1.30.0 lands ant apply — creates or updates agents, environments, and skills from repo-local definition files, with a claude-lock.json lockfile for reproducible deployments. IaC for your Claude Code setup.

Tip of the Day

Screenshot debugging — Paste a screenshot directly into Claude Code. It reads images — great for UI bugs where “it looks wrong” is hard to describe in text.

Have You Seen?

Claude Code IDE extensions — VS Code and JetBrains plugins bring Claude Code into your editor. Sidebar access, inline suggestions, diff review — no terminal switching required.

item.title: Claude Daily Digest — Thu, Sep 3
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.259 lands with org-level MCP server policy and a concurrent session corruption fix; SDK Files/Skills APIs graduate out of beta; /compact tip; prompt caching feature spotlight.
item.content:encoded:
Claude Daily Digest — Thu, Sep 3

📦 What's New

Claude Code v2.1.259 dropped last night:

  • managedMcpServers — Organizations can push HTTP/SSE MCP servers to all users via policy (same shape as .mcp.json). The enterprise path for giving every engineer access to shared internal tools without per-user setup.
  • Concurrent session fix — Running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel was silently corrupting ~/.claude.json, resetting workspace trust and losing MCP state. Now fixed — parallel tmux/terminal workflows are safe.
  • Also: --permission-prompts none for Headless CI runners, GitLab MR badge support (glab mr commands), improved Bash sandboxing for deny rules.

No new Anthropic blog posts in the last 24h.

Claude Daily Digest
Tuesday, Sep 2, 2026
🆕 What's New
Claude Code v2.1.258 — Two bug fixes: macOS 12 (Monterey) users who hit a launch failure after v2.1.255 are unblocked; remote and scheduled sessions crashing with “user messages must have non-empty content” are also fixed.
Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards — Anthropic published a new announcement on co-developing safety standards with enterprise partners.
📄 Docs Changes
No changes this week — Nothing new in the Anthropic docs release notes in the past 7 days.
💡 Tip of the Day

Shift+Tab to auto-accept — Toggle auto-accept mode so Claude applies every edit without prompting.

👀 Have You Seen? — Claude System Prompts

Anthropic's Official Claude System Prompts — Now Public — Anthropic published their internal system prompts in August 2026.
